blockers.title: Production newsletter delivery provider is not selected or integrated
closeCriteria: Select a provider that supports subscription, unsubscribe, bounce handling, and bulk delivery
Integrate the provider without using the transactional verification-email binding
Verify provider idempotency keys or reconciliation so outcome_unknown deliveries cannot be blindly resent
Pass bounce handling and production-representative bulk delivery verification
Pass newsletter reliability tests and one production-safe delivery verification
Record a successful deployed verification artifact in closeEvidence.evidence

blockers.title: Production Worker, D1, Pages, and same-site verification are incomplete
closeCriteria: Configure required Worker and Pages secrets, variables, bindings, and production URLs
Apply the complete D1 migration chain to the production database
Deploy the Worker and Pages artifacts and record their deployment identifiers
Configure Pages and Worker custom domains under the same site so the secure SameSite=Lax session cookie works
Pass deployed GET smoke for the home page, a discovered reading page, API ping, auth session, and subscription status
Send one safe verification email through the deployed verification EMAIL binding and confirm login without recording the code, address, token, or provider body
Record auditable deployment, smoke, and verification-email artifacts in closeEvidence.evidence
